name: Zalgo text
description: A title that something corrupts: combining marks creep over and under its letters in fits, then overrun it in a tangle with a red echo shuddering behind, before it snaps back to plain.

name: Fogged mirror writing
description: Words traced by an unseen finger on a fogged-up mirror, the dark glass showing through each stroke as it is drawn, beads of condensation running down from them, then the fog creeping back over until they are gone.

name: Scratched text
description: Words gouged into a dark surface in a few frantic passes, each scratch a little off the last, the pale gouges filling in behind them, then fading as if they had never been there.

name: Ransom note
description: A message spelled out in letters cut from magazines, each on its own scrap of paper in its own face, size and tilt, slapped down one after another, then torn away.

name: Carved pumpkin text
description: Letters carved through the ribbed orange skin of a pumpkin, a candle inside lighting them up from within, flickering, its glow spilling round the cuts, until it gutters out.

name: Claw tear
description: Claw marks rip across the first picture and tear wider, raw-edged, until the next picture fills the frame through them. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Blood wipe
description: A curtain of blood pours down over the first picture, drips running ahead of it, then drains away from the top to show the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Shadow swallow
description: Darkness with tendril edges closes in from the corners and swallows the first picture, a pair of eyes glinting in it for a moment, then draws back to show the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Static cut
description: The first picture tears and rolls as the signal goes, breaks into TV static, then the next picture tunes in out of it. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Burn through
description: The first picture blisters and burns through from a hot spot, a glowing charred edge spreading out across the frame and the next picture showing through the hole. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Bleeding text
description: A title that starts to bleed: blood seeps down through its letters from the top, drips run from its baseline and swell, a few drops fall, then it all fades back to clean letters.

name: Blood moon
description: A crimson full moon hanging over dark hills and a lone dead tree, its cratered face glowing through drifting clouds, the sky round it stained red and pricked with faint stars.

name: Claw slash
description: Claw marks raked across a picture in a fast stroke, each tear ripping open along its length with ragged raw edges and the picture pulled apart round it, holding a moment, then closing up again. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Blood drip border
description: A glossy band of blood along the top of the frame, drips creeping down from it at their own pace, swelling at their tips and letting drops fall, then thinning away as new ones start; a transparent overlay.

name: Heartbeat vignette
description: A deep red edge round a picture pulsing like a heartbeat, quickening and closing in as the pointer gets nearer a target spot, from a resting pulse up to at most 120 beats a minute; while idle, it drifts nearer and away on its own.

name: Failing light
description: A picture lit by a failing fluorescent tube overhead: humming, catching, stuttering off and back on and sometimes staying dark a while, the room falling into shadow each time. It switches at most three times a second.

name: Subliminal flicker
description: A picture that now and then shows something else for a single frame, a hidden picture laid over it so briefly you are not sure you saw it, never more than once every two seconds.

name: Scare cut
description: A jump scare: a picture slowly closing in, then a sudden cut to a stark face for a split second, the frame punching in and shaking before it settles. Once a cycle, never faster than every three seconds. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Poltergeist
description: An app screen where something unseen takes hold: a card, a button, an avatar and a toggle tremble, lift off and wobble in the air, then slam back down at once, shaking the screen and puffing up dust.

name: Rune glow
description: A word carved into dark stone, its letters lighting up one after another with an inner glow as if a spell were being read, pulsing together once all are lit, then fading back into the stone.
